answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 62873 Country: India Title: Toys business such as plastic dolls, animals, cars and other toys items are permissible? Question: Toys business such as plastic dolls, animals, cars and other toys items are permissible in Islam and Shariah for selling or trading. Is it halal or haram income? Please clear it. Answer ID: 62873 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 130/130/SD=03/1437) The selling and buying of toys is lawful and the income is also halal. However, one should avoid buying or selling the doll of boys as well as toys having pictures. It is makrooh to adopt this business as a profession, but the income derived from this shall be halal. (Jawahir al-Fiqh: 7/263-264, Tasvir Ke Sharai Ahkam, pub. Maktaba Darul Uloom Karachi) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
